# Space8

> Hong Kong's first self-service snooker club. Book a table online, pay by
> Apple Pay or card, and enter with a QR code — no staff required. Open daily
> 06:00–24:00.

Space8 is a self-service snooker (English billiards) venue in Hong Kong.
Members and guests book table time through the website, pay online, and get a
QR code that unlocks entry at the venue. Pricing varies by time period
(afternoon/evening/late-night) and membership tier (Amateur/Century/Maximum),
which unlock discounts and point multipliers.

## Key pages

- [Booking](https://space8.com.hk/book): Book a table — select date, time,
  and duration, then pay.
- [Pricing](https://space8.com.hk/pricing): Hourly rates by time period, and
  membership tier benefits.
- [About](https://space8.com.hk/about): Venue details, hours, contact info.
- [FAQ](https://space8.com.hk/faq): Booking process, entry method, fees,
  cancellation policy, membership points.
- [Blog](https://space8.com.hk/blog): Articles about snooker and the venue.

## Languages

Available in Cantonese (zh-HK, default), Simplified Chinese (zh-CN), English
(en), and Japanese (ja). Non-default locales are prefixed, e.g.
https://space8.com.hk/en/pricing.
